extracted.name: Caprese chicken sandwiches
extracted.description: Get into summer with these chicken ciabatta rolls. Tomatoes, mozzarella and a balsamic dressing evoke the flavours of Italy
ingredient_lines: 2 cooked chicken breasts, skin removed, sliced
instruction_lines: Halve the ciabatta rolls and lightly toast, then rub the garlic clove over the cut sides.

Spread the pesto over the roll bases, then top with the tomatoes, basil leaves, chicken and mozzarella slices, and rocket leaves. Drizzle over the balsamic and sandwich with the roll tops, then serve.
